name: Goldtek Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Goldtek Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 2003 and based in New Taipei City, Taiwan, specializes in the development and production of telecommunications-controlled radio frequency apparatus and robust industrial communication handheld devices, serving both the Taiwanese and Chinese markets. The company presents a diverse portfolio of smart solutions, encompassing various categories. For smart homes, their offerings include cloud and AI-driven DIY cameras (spotlight and panorama models), intelligent door locks and bells, home automation systems, secure smart tablets for surveillance, and cloud-enabled digital photo frames. Their smart living range features products such as smart bicycle locks, pet health trackers, wearable monitoring devices, health-focused wristbands and breast pumps, smartwatches, and smart insoles. Goldtek also develops vehicle IoT products, like automatic Wi-Fi dongles, and provides extensive smart logistics solutions, including portable data collectors, luggage and pallet tracking devices, smart storage cabinets for homes and logistics, and intelligent mailboxes. Additionally, the company delivers Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS), artificial intelligence, and cloud-based services.
